notes: Coordinates are ORIGINAL pixels (x right, y down) of the photo named in "image" (also-entries name their own photo). Image sizes: p26 2500 x 1475, p28 / p29 2500 x 1875, all others 2500 x 1667.

Plan directions follow p29 / roof.json (N = image top of the near-nadir aerial): the house front faces SW; the REAR (pool side) faces NE / E. The rear facade from north to south: one-storey north wing (north chimney, service yard) -> two-storey block NC with the north porch NCP wrapping its NE corner -> the two-storey balcony gable BG (covered patio below, balcony above) -> the open inner garden court (white beam across it, two trees) -> the one-storey patio wing PB (hip roof, covered dining patio on its pool side, enclosed room + stone wall section at its east end) -> the south block with the south chimney on its east wall and the east leg EP of the wraparound porch.

Camera orientation of the rear photos: p21 from above / behind the BBQ counter at the SE end of the pool looking WNW at the rear (left = south: PB, centre = BG, right = NC); p26 from the NW end of the pool looking SE down its length (left = fireplace / lounge, centre = arbor, right = PB patio); p22 from the pool's SW side looking NE at the fireplace (spa at right = SE end, stairs / play structure right); p23 from under the north porch looking E (side lawn left, fireplace centre, pool right); p24 close front-left view of the fireplace and lounge; p20 from behind (SE of) the arbor looking NW through it at the BBQ counter, with BG over the roses; p18 from the synthetic lawn's east end looking W at the house's SE side; p19 the play structure from the south; p27 the rose garden SE of the house looking E (the arbor's dark beams at its upper left); p28 high oblique drone from the NE (over the play area) looking SW.

Materials: walls grey cedar shingles with white trim / corner boards / columns / beams; roofs charcoal asphalt shingles with white gutters and exposed white rafter tails; windows black sashes in white casings; chimneys, fireplace, hearth / planter walls and the counters tan-rust-grey fieldstone ashlar with bluestone caps; deck / porches / walks bluestone flagstone; terrace retaining walls grey segmental concrete block; arbor dark-stained timber on white columns.

Rough metric scale on the rear facade in p21 (BG, from the 0.9 x 2.4 m patio door): ~60 px/m at the BG face; BG ~5.4 m wide, balcony floor ~3.4 m above the patio, railing ~1 m, gable rise ~1.6 m. All est_* attrs are such estimates, not measurements.

The ground-floor porches / patios (NCP, BG patio, PB patio) are one continuous raised bluestone floor 2 risers above the pool deck (steps along their whole fronts); the court between BG and PB is open above the white beam.
